proposal.summary: Authenticated command injection in the VR-3033 web interface ping and traceroute diagnostic pages allows an authenticated attacker to execute OS commands and obtain command output (e.g., directory listing).
proposal.cwe_quote:
4- on the text input, type 'google.fr;ls - l'
5 - a list of folder names should appear.

PR.quote: To reproduce the vulnerability attacker has to access the interface at least with minimum privilege.

C.quote: Remote attackers are able to get full control and compromise the network managed by the router.

I.quote: Remote attackers are able to get full control and compromise the network managed by the router.

A.quote: Remote attackers are able to get full control and compromise the network managed by the router.

proposal.recommended_next_step: Validate the issue by reproducing the PoC in a lab, then remediate by fixing input handling on ping/traceroute (properly validate/escape or avoid passing user input to a shell). Vendor should produce a firmware update; as a mitigation restrict access to the web interface and require strong admin authentication until fixed.
